name: French A2.1
description: In this module, students gain additional basic knowledge of French as a foreign language, enabling them to successfully manage everyday situations, e.g. while travelling, at the doctor, while looking for a place to live, or while talking to colleagues, friends and neighbors. More grammar will be covered, e.g. use of the Passé Composé und Imparfait, the conditional, relative pronouns, en + y pronouns, comparatives and the superlative. Students will learn strategies for successfully communicating in day-to-day situations with minimal language skills. Additionally, opportunities will be made available to more effectively learn French as a foreign language and thus to improve the student's ability to learn.
prerequisites: Sound knowledge of level A1; placement test results A2.1
